offering_description.value: Paycom sells cloud payroll and HR software to employers across industries. Its platform combines payroll, time tracking, recruiting, benefits and talent management, and it helps employers set up the software, process payroll and file payroll taxes.

primary_products.value: Payroll software; time and attendance software; recruiting and onboarding software; benefits administration software; talent management software

primary_services.value: Payroll processing; payroll tax filing; software implementation and data migration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize employers, larger enterprises and nonprofit organizations

end_markets.value: Healthcare; retail; manufacturing; hospitality; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to payroll and HR applications, typically priced by employee count and selected modules; transaction or usage fees: Per-transaction charges for certain payroll and filing activities; service fees: Initial software setup and implementation; interest or premiums: Interest on client funds held before payroll and tax payments are disbursed
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops cloud software that employers use to manage employee records, time, pay and benefits; service provider: Uses employer payroll records and funds to process pay and remit payroll taxes

geography_served.value: global: United States is the core market, with international workforce management and payroll in select markets including Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Payroll, time and labor management, recruiting, benefits administration and talent management on a shared platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house sales teams sell directly to employers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Payroll tax withholding, remittance and reporting under IRS and state rules, plus employee data privacy requirements

notes: The full list of countries with local payroll processing is uncertain.
